clue.text: What comes after I imitate mockery

parts.note: in the alphabet the letter following I is J
to ape someone is to copy them

explanation.surface: Someone owns up that copying another person comes across as ridicule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What comes after I' reads like a sentence about the speaker, but it points to the next letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: A jape is a joke or prank, a piece of teasing fun at someone's expense.

clue.text: Money for nothing

definitions.meaning: first meaning: US slang for money
second meaning: ..., as in 'you know ...', is US slang for nothing at all

explanation.walkthrough: The surface echoes the song line 'money for nothing'; 'for' just joins two senses of the same slang word.
explanation.definitionFit: In American slang the word stands both for cash and, in 'jack squat', for zero.

clue.text: Plan initially devised to create a pattern

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word plan is taken

parts.note: plans that are laid have been devised

explanation.surface: A designer drafts a scheme as the first step toward a new design.
explanation.definitionFit: Plaid is the crisscross tartan design woven into cloth, a kind of check.

clue.text: In the absence of objective fact, send leader of team ahead of Yankee slugger

definitions.text: In the absence of objective fact

parts.note: to post a letter is to send it

indicators.note: the leader is the opening letter of team

parts.note: Babe Ruth, the famous New York Yankees home-run hitter

explanation.surface: A baseball manager, short on hard data, sends a player out ahead of the great Yankee batter.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes a climate where emotion and belief outweigh verifiable facts in public debate.

clue.text: Place outside of Tripoli for naked babies

parts.note: to place something is to put it

indicators.note: the outside of the word Tripoli is its first and last letters

parts.note: the Libyan capital supplies its two end letters

explanation.surface: A spot on the edge of the Libyan capital turns out to be home to unclothed infants.
explanation.definitionFit: Putti are the chubby nude cherubs painted or carved in Renaissance art.

clue.text: Doctors eating a piece of tasty fish

indicators.note: the doctors swallow the extra letter, which goes inside them
just the opening letter of the word tasty is taken

parts.note: tasty gives up its first letter

explanation.surface: Physicians tuck into a morsel of delicious seafood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctors' looks like the definition but supplies the outer letters; the fish is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Sturgeons are large bony river and sea fishes prized for caviar.

clue.text: Badly want family-friendly sound from a banjo

indicators.note: the letters are rearranged as if done badly

parts.note: G is the US film rating for general audiences, suitable for all the family

explanation.surface: Someone craves a wholesome tune plucked on a banjo.
explanation.definitionFit: A twang is the sharp ringing note of a plucked string, typical of banjos.

clue.text: Bearing one child at a time, finally, you almost get excited about small quantity of liquor

definitions.text: Bearing one child at a time

indicators.note: the outer letters go around the small measure of drink
only the closing letter of the word you is taken
the last letter is dropped, so the word is nearly complete

parts.note: a nip is a small drink of spirits

explanation.surface: A mother of single children perks up over a dram.
explanation.definitionFit: Uniparous is the zoological term for producing only one offspring per birth.

clue.text: Some deaths ravaged family dwellings

indicators.note: ravaged suggests something wrecked and broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A grim report of fatalities sweeping through households.
explanation.definitionFit: Homesteads are farmhouses with their land, lived in by a household.

clue.text: Talking software in Panama, for instance, and beginning to babble in bed

indicators.note: the hat and letter are placed in the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
a Panama is a kind of straw hat

indicators.note: the beginning is the opening letter of babble

explanation.surface: Someone in Central America starts murmuring in bed, as if a computer program were chatting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Panama' looks like the country; it is the hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A chatbot is a computer program that converses with users in natural language.

clue.text: Pick up rock and toss jacket

indicators.note: in a down clue, picking up means lifting the letters so they read from bottom to top

parts.note: to lob is to throw high

explanation.surface: Someone lifts a stone and throws away a coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A bolero is a short open jacket ending above the waist.

clue.text: Rotate front of skull 90 degrees with radioactive element

indicators.note: the opening letter of the bony word is turned on its side
turning a C a quarter turn makes it look like a U

explanation.surface: An anatomy instruction to turn a head sideways, paired with a nuclear fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: The change is visual: a C turned through a right angle becomes a U.
explanation.definitionFit: Uranium is the heavy radioactive metal used as nuclear fuel.

clue.text: Monstrous giant taking on most of tedious, mature behavior

indicators.note: monstrous suggests something misshapen, so the letters are reshaped
the final letter is removed, leaving most of the word

explanation.surface: A hulking ogre absorbs boredom and starts acting grown-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Adulting is slang for doing the responsible chores of grown-up life.

clue.text: Philip and Jimmy (two musicians) in a precipitous position for women and minorities

definitions.text: a precipitous position for women and minorities

parts.note: Jimmy Cliff, the Jamaican reggae singer

explanation.surface: Two musicians find themselves in a risky spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes women or minority leaders being promoted into crisis roles where failure is likely.

clue.text: A South American capital beginning to comfort green, inexperienced actress

parts.note: Lima is the capital of Peru

indicators.note: the opening letters of the words comfort and green are taken

parts.note: each word supplies its first letter

explanation.surface: A trip to a Peruvian city starts to soothe a nervous novice performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ali MacGraw is the American film star of Love Story.

clue.text: Group of workers left a foot deformity lined with gold

indicators.note: the precious metal goes inside the swelling, lining it

parts.note: a bunion is a painful swelling on the big toe joint

explanation.surface: A gilded description of a toe ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: A labor union is an organized association of employees bargaining collectively.

clue.text: Porter, e.g., accommodating ruler in Rome, Italy — briefly an advocate of separation from Europe

definitions.text: an advocate of separation from Europe

indicators.note: the beer holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: IT is the short code for Italy

explanation.surface: A dark ale houses an emperor in Rome, giving a quick sketch of Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: A Brexiteer campaigned for the UK to leave the European Union.

clue.text: Vermin allegedly from Scandinavia — or carried by returning sailor (what a bore)

indicators.note: the little word or sits inside the reversed letters
in a down clue the sailor and the bore are read in reverse

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A rodent supposedly hailing from the north travels aboard with a dull seaman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'allegedly' is fair: the brown rat was misnamed and did not come from Norway.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norway rat is the common brown rat, a widespread pest rodent.

clue.text: You and I getting approval for being aware of social injustice

indicators.note: the pronoun gets the approval placed inside it

parts.note: you and I together are we
an OK is a sign of approval

explanation.surface: A couple wins endorsement for their social conscience.
explanation.definitionFit: Woke is slang for being alert to racial and social inequality.

clue.text: Hispanic of any gender is careless to swallow metal

indicators.note: the careless word swallows the metal, holding it inside

explanation.surface: Someone is so negligent they gulp down metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Latinx is a gender-neutral term for people of Latin American descent.

clue.text: Proper athletic event

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an old adjective for fitting or proper

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an archaic adjective for suitable and a noun for a track or swimming competition.

clue.text: Entered illegally, with locks broken by personal assistants

indicators.note: the assistants split the hairy word apart by sitting inside it

parts.note: tressed means having tresses, locks of hair
a PA is a personal assistant; PAS is the plural

explanation.surface: Intruders got in after aides smashed the door locks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'locks' suggests door locks, but they are locks of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: To trespass is to go onto someone's property without permission.

clue.text: See 12
Chip: fit or out of shape?

indicators.note: the letters are bent out of their shape, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether a snack leaves you healthy or flabby.
explanation.definitionFit: Fritos is a US brand of corn chip, a crunchy snack.

clue.text: Racist movement sounds totally unoriginal

indicators.note: the answer is said out loud like the two words

explanation.surface: A jab that a bigoted ideology is utterly hackneyed.
explanation.definitionFit: The alt-right is a far-right movement promoting white nationalism online.

clue.text: At first, throw a garden tool in the lake

indicators.note: only the opening letter of throw is used

parts.note: a hoe is a weeding tool

explanation.surface: A gardener begins by hurling a weeding implement into the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Tahoe is a large freshwater lake in the Sierra Nevada between California and Nevada.

clue.text: In Denmark, a cozy quality (like a soufflé) rises after hours

indicators.note: the reversed word comes after the letter for hours
in a down clue rising means reading upwards

parts.note: a soufflé is made of eggs, so it is eggy

explanation.surface: A homely evening when a soufflé puffs up after a long bake.
explanation.definitionFit: Hygge is the Danish idea of snug contentment and comfortable warmth.

clue.text: Called up to growl

indicators.note: in a down clue the letters are read upwards

explanation.surface: Someone phoned just to snarl.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnar is an old imitative verb meaning to snarl, the noise an angry dog makes.

clue.text: Dancer, perhaps stepping back, missing violin finale and sounding more like an oboe

indicators.note: what remains walks backwards, read in reverse
the violin's last letter is lost from the deer

parts.note: Dancer is one of Santa's reindeer

indicators.note: the finale of violin is its closing letter

explanation.surface: A ballet dancer retreats without the violin's closing bars, the music turning thin and nasal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dancer' looks like a ballerina; it is one of Santa's sleigh-pullers.
explanation.definitionFit: An oboe is a reed instrument, so a thinner, nasal tone is reedier.

clue.text: Former Attorney General invested in sweetheart's idea for a massive Defense Department expansion?

definitions.text: idea for a massive Defense Department expansion?

indicators.note: the ex-official is put inside the endearment

parts.note: hon, short for honey, is an endearment

explanation.surface: A retired top lawyer is backing a lover's plan to enlarge the military.
explanation.walkthrough: The Defense Department sits in the five-sided Pentagon; adding a side gives six.
explanation.definitionFit: A six-sided figure is a playful upgrade on the five-sided Pentagon building.

clue.text: "Fight back frequently!"—cry for attention contained in valuable 2016 honorific awarded by the editors of the Oxford Dictionaries to one of nine finalists in the completed grid

definitions.text: 2016 honorific awarded by the editors of the Oxford Dictionaries to one of nine finalists in the completed grid

indicators.note: the quarrel is read backwards
the two words sit inside the valuable one

parts.note: something dear is costly or valuable
oft is an old word for often
hey is called out to get attention

explanation.surface: A rallying call to resist, packed into a long description of a dictionary award.
explanation.walkthrough: Oxford chose POST-TRUTH in 2016; the shortlist words fill the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: Oxford's lexicographers annually name one term as the expression capturing that year's mood.

clue.text: See 29
